intro.text:
This toy boat hull is free to move up and down. The water forces decide how it bobs.

Side slice: blue is water, dark is air.

outro.text:
The water moves the hull, and the hull moves the water: both are solved together every time step.

OpenFOAM interFoam · 6-DoF rigid body · morphing mesh

captions.text: The 50 g hull was let go while pushed too deep: buoyancy is four times its weight.
It shoots up 3 cm in a fifth of a second, overshooting the height where it would float.
Then it drops back and bounces, each swing smaller than the last.
The mesh stretches and squeezes to follow the hull, so nothing has to be remeshed.
Small bobbing continues. This run stopped at 1.79 s of the planned 3 s.
